The [[corsair]]s learned what happened to their last raiding party, and are back in force outside [[Kodlonu Hamlet]]. Help [[Elder Olunideh]] to wipe them out for good!

==Quest information==

===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
 |campaign = Nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
* Go with the men of the village and Elder Olunideh and drive the corsairs away from [[Istan]]i soil.
* See Elder Olunideh for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 125 [[Gold]]
* 15 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* [[Battle Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
Enter [[Mehtani Keys]] and meet up with Elder Olunideh and 4 [[Istani Commoner]]s. This quest is almost exactly the same as the previous quest, but there are about 30 enemies instead of 10, separated into two groups of about 15 corsairs apiece. These groups can, with a bit of luck, be separated further into groups of four or five. Take out both groups and see Elder Olunideh for your reward.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Elder Olunideh
:''"Greetings, <Player name>. Not long ago, you helped us drive a small band of '''corsairs''' from our lands. They must have gotten a message to their ships about our village, because a large party of corsairs has landed on that same island. I've evacuated all fisher folk from the area. Now we must move against these vermin before they get too comfortable. Again we must ask the [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]] for help."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Of course we are with you. Lead the way. The people of this land need you, will you heed their call?
|decline = Now is not a good time.
|ask = Meet me in '''Mehtani Keys''' and we will take care of the '''corsair''' scum who dare set foot here. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Elder Olunideh
:''"Come, men! These corsairs will show our families no mercy, so we will drive them out!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Elder Olunideh
:''"Your help in this mission has been invaluable. I see now why you were chosen to be a Sunspear. Your courage will lead you to greatness."''
